name: Magpie 模型网关
description: 可选下载的 magpie 本机模型网关（yetone/magpie 原版程序，MIT）。统一管理 API 密钥、订阅登录账号与路由组，查看额度与用量，并在会话中使用它的模型。取代订阅中心与 WorkBuddy 号池。

features.name: magpie 原版网关：按需启动、私有数据目录、禁用即停
features.nameEn: Original magpie gateway: on-demand start, private data folder, stops when disabled

features.name: API 密钥供应商与密钥池
订阅账号登录、本机登录发现与额度窗口
features.nameEn: Subscription sign-ins, local sign-in discovery and quota windows

features.name: 路由组：顺序、轮换与额度感知切换
features.nameEn: Routing groups: order, rotation and quota-aware failover

features.name: magpie 模型与路由组进入会话模型选择
features.nameEn: magpie models and routing groups in conversation model selection
